value.name: affirm mother's love as strength
value.description: Rosa reassures Lucia that their mother's love will sustain them and remain present in the house.
evidence: Rosa: "Exactly, Lucia; her love is our strength, and with each discovery, we’ll ensure her spirit remains woven into this home, guiding us forward."

value.name: urge opening the box
value.description: Rosa proposes opening the box to examine letters and photographs that may reveal their mother's legacy.
evidence: Rosa: "Let’s open the box now and see what pieces of her heart await us; each letter and photograph could be a thread connecting us to her legacy."

value.name: resolve to uncover mother's heart
value.description: Lucia agrees to uncover the contents of the box and face whatever they learn about their mother.
evidence: Lucia: "I can almost hear her voice in my mind, urging us to find the courage within ourselves; let’s uncover her heart and hold it close, no matter what we discover."

value.name: invoke mother's wishes
value.description: Rosa insists that they honor their mother's wishes by uncovering the truth together.
evidence: Rosa: "Lucia, remember, our mother's spirit is woven into every corner of this house; it’s time we honor her wishes and uncover the truth together."

value.name: interpret box contents as clues
value.description: Rosa explains that the items in the box each tell a story and may reveal the choices their mother made.
evidence: Rosa: "Look closely, Lucia; each item in this box tells a story, and together they hold the key to understanding her heart and the choices she made for us."

value.name: lucia fears painful revelations
value.description: Lucia admits she feels the emotional weight of the letters but fears the truth could divide them.
evidence: Lucia: I can feel the weight of her love in every letter, but I'm scared of what we might uncover; will it bring us closer or tear us apart?

value.name: reassure truth will bind them
value.description: Rosa counters Lucia's fear by saying the truth will ultimately unite them if they face it openly.
evidence: Rosa: "Fear is natural, Lucia, but it’s the truth that will ultimately bind us; let’s face whatever comes with open hearts and unwavering love."

value.name: lucia worries truth may hurt
value.description: Lucia says she fears the truth may bring more pain than love and threaten what remains of their bond.
evidence: Lucia: "I want to believe that, Rosa, but what if the truth reveals more pain than love? I can’t bear the thought of losing what little we have left."

value.name: frame truth as healing
value.description: Rosa insists that even painful truth can lead to healing and understanding through their mother's love.
evidence: Rosa: "Lucia, the truth may be difficult, but it’s also a path to healing; we must trust that our mother’s love will guide us through the pain and into understanding."
